sources.used_for: water.png, and to choose between the shaded and unshaded Blue Marble per pixel

maps.albedo-MM.jpg: Surface albedo per month (MM = 01..12), linear, sRGB-encoded: decode as sRGB to get albedo. Land from the relief-shaded map (the shading is baked in, lit from a fixed direction); water from the unshaded map. The inversion of the BMNG display stretch is stated in the script.
maps.clouds.jpg: Cloud cover 0..1, stored linearly (not sRGB). c = (DN/255)^1. A single moment in 2002, not the current weather.
maps.lights.jpg: Night-light radiance relative to the brightest 3 km Black Marble pixel, sRGB-encoded. The absolute scale is a model (see the script and src/earth/earthShader.ts).
maps.water.png: Fraction of each pixel that is water (oceans, seas, lakes), 0..1, linear.
